parameters.jsCode: const results=$('Research Competitor').first().json?.results||[];const input=$('Validate Input').first().json;const competitorContext=results.map(r=>r.title+': '+(r.content||r.snippet||'').slice(0,300)).join('\n');return[{json:{input,competitorContext:competitorContext||'No public competitor data found.'}}];

values.content: You write competitive battle cards for sales teams. Good battle cards are honest about competitor strengths (reps need to know what they're actually up against), give specific response scripts not vague talking points, identify which deal situations favor you and which favor the competitor, and help reps steer the conversation rather than just defend. Always respond in valid JSON only.
